title: Standing Note on Supplier Advice That a Booked Vehicle Is Not Available
content:
Where the supplier advises that the booked vehicle class is not available, the renter is given the nearest
available class at no additional charge, and a class above the one booked never carries an upcharge. The
substitution basis across the Car Rental Rate Classes is the nearest available class at or above the class
booked.

## Where nothing at all is available

Where no vehicle at all is available the rental is cancelled free of charge on every rate class and any
prepayment is returned in full.

A renter who declines a substitute vehicle is treated as cancelling free of charge and not as a no-show.

## What follows the rate class rather than the vehicle

The included mileage, the protection products and the fuel arrangement follow the rate class booked and not
the substitute vehicle actually provided. A renter moved up to a larger vehicle therefore keeps the mileage
allowance, the protection terms and the fuel arrangement of the class they bought.

## Where several notices stand

Several notices about the same rental are not added together; the last notice standing before collection
decides what is owed.

A notice withdrawn by the supplier before collection gives rise to no concession at all.

| Notices standing on a rental before collection | What decides what is owed |
| --- | --- |
| one notice | that notice |
| three notices, none withdrawn | the last of them standing before collection |
| one notice, withdrawn before collection | nothing is owed under this head |
